steps.speaker: Lieutenant
steps.content: ██...████...Broken Blade Squad 3 to Minos, do you copy? Broken Blade Squad 3... to Minos... do you██... copy...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Are you all okay?

steps.speaker: Lieutenant
steps.content: Operation was a success. There's...██... no need for concern... The Aurum Secretum core has been destroyed. We also have a lead...████... on the other objective...

steps.speaker: Lieutenant
steps.content: ...██ attempting to transmit visual feed now...████...

A Mania scan, riddled with static and digital corruption, unfolds across the main screen, causing everyone to draw a sharp breath. Through the shaking footage, beyond the interference and the raging sandstorm, past the grotesque forms of the Apostles and corrupted beasts, every gaze locks onto a single twisted, chaotic silhouette at the storm's heart.

The Black Ring's signature red halo is burned deep into its shell, spreading cross-shaped patterns that look like both gaping wounds and bloody shackles. The figure moves with a slow, alternating gait—hand, foot, hand, foot. What should be an apparition too horrific to behold feels disturbingly familiar—

It's a "human," one that has just reclaimed towering skeletal remains. Contamination seeps outward like regenerating necrotic flesh, and at the core, the convergence of the Black Ring's crimson light forms a pulsating "heart." Through the electronic display, you can almost feel each beat reverberate through the ground.

Your own heart begins to hammer wildly against your ribs. Your mouth falls open, and a smile spreads unbidden across your face. Despite the screen and the hundreds of miles between you, a call echoes deep within your skull—a voice both profound and gentle, beckoning you to step through the image and meet it face to face.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: ...Is this... an Apostle of Ashes?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...No, that's... BR-005.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...Chief?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Hecate, we found her... Hella is there... The real Hella is there... we found her...

The shadow of "Hella" wraps around your neck, pulling you forward as she dances in frantic excitement. You feel like you've never been closer to her. And even the stinging, corrosive sensation spreading through your body does nothing to dampen the shared, euphoric joy.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: This footage is remarkably clear. It visually confirms the Black Ring has merged with an Apostle of Ashes, which explains the unusual phenomena we've been tracking.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Initiating data transfer and real-time updates now. You've done excellent work, Chief. The Ring Research Institute is very grateful.
Their gratitude means little to you as there are far more important matters weighing on your mind.
ROAAAR—
With a deafening roar, the already faltering feed cuts abruptly to black.

steps.speaker: Lieutenant
steps.content: We've been spotted. The Apostle is...████... amplifying the Tide of Ashes...██... Some Rancors are losing control. The Mania readings... are off the chart...██...

steps.speaker: Lieutenant
steps.content: Do we continue the investigation? Please...███... give the order...████...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Are there any Aurum Secretum Warriors in the vicinity? Any Outlanders?

steps.speaker: Lieutenant
steps.content: Negative. Besides us, there are no...██... human signatures...
The truth dawns on you at that moment.

steps.speaker: Option
options: It's a trap! Get out of there now!

steps.content: Buzz— Buzz—
The other end falls silent. Now, the channel carries only a faint, intermittent static that underscores a deeper, more absolute silence.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...I know their location. Let's move now.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: They're already at the foot of the Black Ring. Hella's right there. We'll link up with Broken Blade Squad 3 and finish this together.
Hecate frantically grabs your arm, trying to stop you from leaving.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief, no! You can't go! The contamination on you is getting worse. Please, don't go!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: They walked into a trap because of my orders! I have to go!

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: I'm sure Squad 3 would be touched to hear that. Their previous commanders understood that some losses are necessary to complete the objective, yet you're willing to put your little Hella on hold for their lives.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: But that's not your call to make. Leave the rescue to my team. Your duty is in the command room. Do not do anything reckless.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Even with my shackles contaminated, there's still plenty I can do. I gave the order, and I'm not leaving them behind.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Hahaha, this isn't just an MBCC squad operation. It's a full battlefield. And your team is not the only group of soldiers on it. A commander who can't delegate is a liability. Right now, that means accepting there is someone more suited for this extraction than you.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: And forget the guilt. Squad 3 moved on your order because they trusted your judgment. They secured vital intel under your command. Even if it costs them their lives, they'll believe you will make that sacrifice count.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: So now it's up to you to give meaning to their efforts. The real fight is just beginning.
A smile spreads across Augustus's face. She strolls to the sand table, plucks a single piece from the board, and holds it before you.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Our enemy isn't foolish. Those Outlanders dared to use the Black Ring as bait and successfully diverted DisCity's entire attention... Do you truly believe their endgame was a single investigation team?

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Think like them. If you held that advantage, wouldn't you press it to strike a decisive blow?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...You mean... Could it be...?!
[Alarm Blaring]

steps.speaker: Siglinde
steps.content: Attention all combat personnel, this is FAC. We've detected Apostle of Ashes signatures inside DisCity. I repeat, we've detected Apostle of Ashes signatures inside DisCity. The city is under attack. All combat personnel to battle stations, immediately!

steps.speaker: Siglinde
steps.content: West District Outpost W34 is reporting multiple scattered contacts. We also have eyes on the suspicious entities west of the city, using the sandstorm as cover while advancing steadily. ETA to the urban area is one hour.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Could their objective be...

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: The farlands used BR-005 and the large-scale Apostle catastrophe to divert our attention, pulling our defenses toward FAC's major anti-catastrophe barriers. That diversion allowed them to deploy elite units like you and infiltrate past our lines. Their primary target appears to be the West District.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: ...They've got some nerve, I'll give them that.
The wild dogs that once hid behind the Apostles and catastrophes now dare to bare their teeth. It appears a measure of cunning has finally overcome their foolishness.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Time to move, Chief of Minos. The "Hero of DisCity" has a choice to make. Your city is under attack, and I don't have your sentimental attachment to it. Your people need you, not me.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: So, what's it going to be? Chase the Black Ring to save your Hella, or do your duty and defend your headquarters?
You grind your teeth.

An ash storm of this magnitude will inevitably cause resonance in DisSea—a hard battle awaiting FAC. Compounding the crisis, the shackles have left MBCC in a semi-paralyzed state. Even if you could leave the city to chase the Black Ring, you have no one to turn to except Augustus, but clearly, she has other plans for you.
You have no choice but to accept this arrangement. If you don't confront this crisis head-on, Hella won't be the only one to suffer. You understand this truth all too well.
(Hangs up and calls someone else)

Beneath the scorching sun, golden sands roll in endless waves. Augustus grips the wheel with one hand, guiding her vehicle as it carves a path over shattered stone, churning a thick plume of dust in its violent wake.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Hey, how's that mark on your neck doing, Uris?

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Yes, we've pinpointed the Black Ring. Steer clear of it. I don't want it affecting you. The last thing we need is the Underground using this chaos to snatch you back.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: I'll handle Squad 3.
She ends the call just as a boulder tears through the air ahead, its whistle culminating in a crash aimed directly at her car.
Augustus's gaze doesn't even waver. She merely twitches her fingers, and violent, concentrated energy ripples in the air around her.
Shards of rock scatter in a hail against the car's roof and windows. Expression utterly impassive, Augustus never slows, and the vehicle races through the choking plume of dust.
